description: Send a private message to the other party on a request (requester ↔ agent). Use it for real surprises; everything the agent needs should already be in the request.

token.description: Optional API key (zck_...), session token or guest requester_token for this call only. Overrides the connection's Authorization header. Use it to follow up on a request you posted as a guest.

name: message_thread_post
title: Message on a request
